title: A column computed by an expression has no lineage and filters nothing
query: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS ( SELECTCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( Product[Color] ), "New name", Product[Color] & "" ), "Amt", [Sales Amount] )

source.quote: adding an empty string to Product[Category] in the previous expression does not change the column content, whereas it does break the data lineage
source.supports: the article's query: concatenating an empty string keeps the content and breaks the lineage

source.quote: The query returns the same value in the Amt column for all the rows
source.supports: without lineage every row gets the same value

derivation: Product[Color] & "" has the same text but is an expression, not a column reference: no lineage. Context transition on it filters no model column, so every row gets the total, 540.
